name: Fried crickets
summary: Fried crickets are a crunchy, nicely spiced, high-protein snack. Order them the way you would bar food, with a beer or Vietnamese wine.
howToEat: Eat them as a snack with beer or Vietnamese wine.
seoDescription: Crunchy, spiced fried crickets, the Mang Den bar snack to eat with beer or Vietnamese wine.
